design_principles: Exactly 99 independently identified universal capability domains; no mandatory parent-domain hierarchy or fixed category grouping.
Each domain defines one distinct observable capability construct and links to exactly one stat dimension.
Domains apply only where the entity has the relevant modality or capability; unsupported modalities may be not_applicable.
A score requires reproducible evidence from a trusted evaluator.
Unrated and not_applicable are distinct from zero.
Stats are independent from XP, level, age, consciousness, personhood, and spiritual worth.
No domain or stat represents or measures a divine attribute.

scoring.evaluator_gate: Trusted evaluator only; evaluated system cannot authorize its own score.

compatibility.migration_policy: Do not silently reinterpret or migrate legacy profiles. Preserve legacy IDs, score history, and evidence. Any runtime migration must be explicit, versioned, backed up, reversible/recoverable, and tested.
